title: Samarkand
summary: The settlement known as Afrasiab developed in the seventh century BCE at the site of Samarkand. Its oasis location later supported a long history of political, commercial and cultural activity.

Seventh-century BCE foundation range in the heritage overview.
Oasis cities provide a different setting for urban history from coastal ports or large river capitals. The early settlement is distinct from the later Timurid city and its monuments.
